scenes: Wide establishing interior of the Heavenly Demon Sect's great hall at night: immense sect banners, flames beyond far doorway, exhausted disciples retreating while older sect leader Yan stands between them and invading soldiers. He commands protection, not a coronation. Frame his silhouette and the hall.

Close a departing adult disciple's two hands respectfully offering a small plain white porcelain cup of dark tea to older Yan. Yan accepts and sips, trusting him without looking away from distant battle. The disciple face stays shadowed and unidentifiable, no special ring emblem. A light visual cue of trust, no obvious poison bottle.

Invading armored soldiers charge through the doorway at older Yan; he places the SAME white cup on a short stone ledge near steps, calmly rests right hand on jian hilt. Clear spatial connection cup ledge and battlefield.

Big dramatic older Yan right-handed horizontal jian slash at attacking soldiers, thick sweeping impact trajectory, weapons break and soldiers thrown back, no gore. Low angle makes overwhelming skill readable. No allies join him.
Aftermath in SAME fortress doorway: defeated enemy soldiers' weapons on floor, older Yan remains unwounded standing. He lowers jian and turns toward the hall behind him. The fight has ended.

View from behind older Yan into SAME abandoned hall: empty ranks, broken sect banner hanging, scattered disciples' abandoned cloaks, retreating silhouettes very far away. His extended empty left hand asks where his people are; loneliness not triumph.

Old steward Qiu, age86 white beard pale patched robe, stumbles into SAME hall supporting a wrapped wound at ribs; clutching a single scorched child-sized cloth shoe in other hand. Yan rushes to support him by elbow before he falls. Non-graphic injury.

Medium close older Yan kneels supporting fading old Qiu against a column. Qiu offers the small scorched child's shoe, ash and exhaustion show he came from burned home village. Yan looks at shoe then Qiu in stunned recognition, no smile.

FLASHBACK three days earlier, same older Yan and white-bearded old Qiu alive and healthy in fortress council chamber. Qiu pleading and pointing to an ordinary village position on cloth map; worried, trying to persuade rather than bowing low. Pale soft panel edges distinguish memory. Yan listens stiffly.

FLASHBACK continued same table: older Yan closes his fist firmly on the capital fortress marker and turns away from the pleading Qiu, explicitly refusing to spare soldiers. Qiu's hand remains extended over village marker, rejected. Faces clear.

BACK TO PRESENT burned great hall: close Qiu's thin hand with child-sized scorched shoe loosens and falls still against Yan's sleeve. Yan tries to hold his wrist, shock. Show death through slack hand and stopped movement, no blood or gore. Same robe and shoe.

Older Yan bows over Qiu's motionless body against column and presses the cold hand between both hands; crown still on Yan, jian set safely on ground. He understands his decision cost the village and this companion. Focus grief on face and hand.

Older Yan alone rises from dead Qiu in SAME burned hall, suddenly grips chest and coughs small dark stain into palm; face shocked at poison taking effect, legs buckle. He is not stabbed or defeated by an attacker. White tea cup on stone ledge clearly visible in background.

Close matching SAME plain white cup fallen on floor spilling dark tea. Older Yan's reflected face in dark pool, one poison-darkened droplet below his mouth; shadowed departing disciple's empty sleeve at far edge, unidentifiable. His understanding of betrayal is the focus, no magic.

Older Yan collapses seated next to motionless Qiu at column, crown falls from his head onto wet stone, sword remains beside him. He looks from empty hall to Qiu, profound regret not rage, no active enemies.

Extreme close older Yan's face and one hand reaching toward Qiu, eyes closing at last exhale; black pencil shadows dissolve to unmarked white at bottom. Clear final stillness of death, no young version, no supernatural portal or second body.
Young Yan wakes with hand grasping his throat on a wooden bed in shabby mountain shrine; morning white light, startled not smiling.
Close reflection in bronze washbasin: young unscarred face, black topknot, hands touch cheek; recognition.
Steward Qiu alive at doorway carrying linen bandages and a cracked water bowl; Yan freezes at sight.
Yan kneels touching living Qiu's warm wrist; surprised steward steadies him, Yan's eyes wet but held controlled.
Close Yan grips old plain jian, sheath rests beside it, checks familiar right hand form.
Yan traces one precise short slash through falling drop over bowl; drop splits in two, bowl remains intact.
Wide shabby shrine: eight exhausted adult sect survivors and scarce tied grain sacks, dying fire, patched roof; Qiu shows two fingers.
Yan ties scabbard at left waist and gives Qiu his small money pouch, stands determined facing mountain path; he is leaving to find people.
Mountain market gate under tall black auction pennant, Yan enters foreground with jian sheathed, chained adult captives led to platform.
Mo Sheng in chains shields a sick older captive from guard's stick by putting his shoulder between; fierce eyes.
Close Mo's bleeding cuff and thumb pulling an iron splinter from floor, resourceful not passive; tiny nick only.
Yan in crowd watches Mo's stance, attentive eyes; match-framed faint adult Mo as legendary swordsman behind him, memory only pale borderless impression.
Auctioneer Du displays Mo with chain raised like livestock; buyers seated below, Yan at edge not bidding.
Mo looks at another captive coughing, slides his only cup of water to them with shackled hands.
Yan opens empty pouch: two coins; sees crowded row of chained captives behind Mo, realizes choosing one abandons others.
Bald head guard raises curved knife toward Mo's RIGHT hand as punishment for protecting sick captive; Mo draws back, action before contact.
Yan's RIGHT hand catches knife flat between two fingers, clean controlled block, Mo's hand unharmed below; bold hard contact burst.
Wider: Yan stands between Mo and bald guard, plain jian still sheathed at left waist; nobody else moves yet.
Head guard tries hauling knife free with both hands, Yan's two fingers unmoving; guard face strains.
Yan twists only wrist, knife cracks in half away from captive; white sharp fracture arc, Mo looks up in shock.
Four armed guards vault stall toward Yan, paths converging; Yan calmly rests right hand on jian hilt.
Close Yan pushes sheath backward with left thumb, right hand starting draw, bright blade edge.
Hero action: Yan right-handed drawing slash in one complete low horizontal arc disarms the nearest two guards, severed weapon shafts fly outward; no body cuts.
Two further guards halt as their belts and weapon straps fall, Yan blade already down, market boards split shallowly in exact straight line.
Du on high auction platform releases a thin black wire from ring toward captive Mo's neck; malicious urgency.
Yan spots wire crossing sunlight, eyes focus, blade changes angle upward; Mo not yet caught.
Hero right-handed upward jian cut severs wire in midair, giant white ribbon anchored to sword from low left toward upper right.
Severed wire recoils around auction post behind Du, post chips, Du ducks own attack, captives recoil safely.
Nearby falling pole knocks oil lamp toward wooden captive pen, flame begins at straw; elderly captive trapped behind bars.
Mo hooks broken shackle chain around falling pole using both hands, braces bare feet; effort visible.
Yan pauses pursuit of Du to look toward Mo saving the older captive, recognises the choice.
Yan thrusts sword through pen padlock precisely, left hand shielding elder behind him, lock breaks without striking bars or person.
Pen gate opens; Mo guides elderly captive out, Yan points other captives toward broad open alley not crowd bottleneck.
Bald guard secretly reaches for crossbow behind stall, aiming at Mo's back.
Yan sees reflected crossbow in blade, turns head as finger pulls trigger; Mo busy helping elder.
Close Yan flicks jian to split crossbow bolt mid-flight ahead of Mo's back; two bolt halves diverge, single white sharp burst.
Bald guard charges with long heavy polearm toward Yan; Yan stands with blade low, captives out of line.
Low angle Yan steps INTO polearm reach outside blade edge, right hand begins short rising stroke; soles firmly on timber.
Huge action Yan's rising jian cuts polearm head from shaft, pressure ribbon rips overhead auction banner into two; no flesh cut, right shoulder leads.
Guard kneels holding broken shaft; Yan's flat blade stops at his throat, cloth fluttering descends, crowd silent.
Du tips a hot coal brazier toward contracts chest beside cloth awnings to destroy evidence; Yan sees from a distance.
Yan leaves defeated guard alive and pivots toward spreading coals; Mo already pulls captives away.
Yan slices empty hanging canvas free, broad sword gust drops it over coals, extinguishing fire; no harm to people.
Mo carries dizzy elder into safe alley; freed adults form water line, collaborative rescue, smoke diminishing.
Du flees with coin box, his boot crushes a poor stall woman's grain basket.
Yan blocks Du with FLAT sword at chest height; tied captives no longer present; coins spill from box.
Stall woman gathers ruined grain and glares at Yan, who notices her injured finger and collapsed awning.
Yan looks from coins to damaged stall and freed people, understands victory's collateral cost, tight face close-up.
Yan gives recovered coins to stall woman, reserving only a tiny portion; Du now tied behind.
Stall woman points at damaged roof beams and pushes a coin back, she needs usable shelter not only money.
Yan kneels to lift fallen roof beam with bare left hand, jian SHEATHED at waist, physically helps repair.
Mo and two freed adults join beam lifting without being ordered; woman loosens defensive grip on coins.
Town constable arrives with two officers at market gate; sees tied Du and free captives.
Constable holds official seal, Du offers slave contract from ground; law backs cruel owner.
Mo steps forward and tears his OWN debt contract, locks eyes with constable, chooses freedom.
Yan stands BESIDE Mo with sheathed sword, not obscuring him; constable lowers seal and opens road.
Freed adults hesitate outside archway, afternoon wind, some reunite and others have nowhere to go.
Mo faces Yan warily, freed hands clenched; demands to know rescue price.
Close Yan recalls old self making young soldiers kneel in throne room, ghostlike memory; regret.

Yan places SHEATHED jian on ground between himself and Mo, opens both hands and meets Mo at same eye level. His unlocked discarded wrist cuffs lie clearly on the ground between them; Mo now has bare wrists.
Mo begins to kneel, Yan gently stops him with hand on shoulder, no dominance.
Mo touches freed RIGHT wrist, resentment and uncertainty easing, no shackle returns.
Freed older woman asks about shelter, points to storm cloud beyond mountain; all group exhausted.
Yan weighs tiny coin purse while looking at huddled people, realizes responsibility before speaking.
Yan points at abandoned sect granary uphill, recognizable sloping tiled roof, path and cliffs.
Group climbs same path; Mo supports elder, Yan in front checks behind; twilight.
Granary already occupied by refugee farmers and families under patched blankets; hoes resting against entrance.
Tenant farmer blocks threshold with open hand, Yan stops and raises empty hands, chooses not to seize shelter.
Farmer shows near-empty grain sack and thin water bowl, protecting those already inside.
Qiu arrives from neighboring damaged shrine with granary key, worried to see too many hungry people.
Yan takes sect jade signet from belt and BREAKS it into two pieces against rock with hand, not sword.
Yan offers precious half signet to farmer for grain and shared shelter, keeps other half, farmer reluctantly accepts.
Rain: Yan and freed adults carry planks toward leaking outer shed while farmer directs repair, Qiu holds lantern.
Mo cuts rotten wood peg with salvaged SHORT blade, exact protective movement, skill glimpsed in useful work.
Yan braces heavy beam while farmer secures wedge, mutual work in rain; jian safely sheathed.
Night: group sits dry under repaired shed by lantern, water jug shared, no banquet, exhausted relief.
Qiu shows Yan almost empty sack and gestures toward twenty sleeping people, tomorrow's hunger clear.
Farmer looks at black crescent carved on half jade, questions which sect Yan belongs to.
Mo volunteers at door with borrowed SHORT sword lowered, no kneeling; determined eyes.
Yan sees Mo willingly standing beside him; pale memory of empty battlefield replaced by living companion, restrained relief.
Dawn: Mo practices protective cut with short sword, Yan corrects elbow using two fingers, no sudden mastery.
Qiu sets broken iron tongs and physician's herb pouch on floor; Yan plans finding craftsman and doctor.
Elsewhere in valley adult physician Shen Lian hooded in pale travel robes flees two masked mounted pursuers while hugging medicine box.
Close pursuer glove bears broken-ring emblem from old betrayal, identity hidden, ties threat to future recruitment.
Yan attaches repaired black crescent sect banner to humble shed roof by hand; no kneeling followers.
Mo stands beside Yan while farmer and Qiu continue repair behind, rebuilding is work.
Wide low-angle Yan walks down mountain path at dawn, Mo follows freely holding sheathed short sword, journey forward.
Close Yan solemn face, LEFT palm holds remaining half jade signet and RIGHT hand rests on plain jian hilt, vow implied, empty sky behind.
dialogue:
天魔神教 教主
燕無咎　四十八歳

ここは俺が守る
皆は下がれ

村の子らを…
救えませなんだ

村へ援軍を！
今ならまだ…

都が先だ
兵は出さぬ

俺が
行かせなかった

敵より近くに
裏切りがあった

王になれば
守れると思った

もう一度だけ…
今度こそ…

傷も白髪も
なくなっている

無咎？
熱は引いたか

丘爺…？
生きているのか

二十二にもなって
寝ぼけおって

残りは八人
米も二日分じゃ

この人には
手を出すな

逆らう奴には
剣も持てぬ

一人買って
他を捨てるか

こっちだ！
まだ動ける

あいつは
先に人を見た

走れる者は
右の路地へ

お前には
長すぎる

次は
柄も要らぬか

証文ごと
燃えちまえ！

これで今夜
何を売れって？

勝てば済むと
また思ったか

壊した分だ
受け取ってくれ

梁は銭だけで
立ちはしない

ここを
持てばいいか

騒ぎを
起こしたのは？

証文がある
そいつは俺の物だ

異論なら
俺が聞く

帰る家が
ない者は？

跪かせた先に
誰もいなかった

古い蔵がある
雨はしのげる

追い出しには
来ていない

俺たちにも
余りはない

鍵ならあるが
中の者は…

印一つより
生きた屋根だ

半分の米と
軒を貸してくれ

貸すのは軒だ
屋根は直せ

この腐った所
切ればいいか

ああ
そのまま支えろ

今度は
一日分じゃぞ

その紋
天魔神教か

俺は残る
俺が決めた

刃より先に
守る場所を見ろ

次は医者と
鍛冶屋が要る

薬だけは
渡せない

俺一人なら
また滅びる
